 1205 Battle::AbilityEffects::DamageCalcFromUser.add(:ANALYTIC,
 1206   proc { |ability, user, target, move, mults, power, type|
 1207     # NOTE: In the official games, if another battler faints earlier in the
 1208     #       round but it would have moved after the user, then Analytic does not
 1209     #       power up the move. However, this makes the determination so much
 1210     #       more complicated (involving pbPriority and counting or not counting
 1211     #       speed/priority modifiers depending on which Generation's mechanics
 1212     #       are being used), so I'm choosing to ignore it. The effect is thus:
 1213     #       "power up the move if all other battlers on the field right now have
 1214     #       already moved".
 1215     if move.pbMoveFailedLastInRound?(user, false)
 1216       mults[:power_multiplier] *= 1.3
 1217     end
 1218   }
 1219 )
